summary: Contestants will demonstrate a basic understanding of foundational business knowledge by completing an objective test. The event is open to any middle level contestant and lasts no more than sixty minutes.
time_limits: no more than sixty (60) minutes testing time
what_to_bring: Cordless calculator: electronic devices will be monitored according to ACT standards. See NLC Calculator Guidelines. Contestants who violate this rule will be disqualified.
competencies: Analyze effective communication across multiple platforms using verbal, written, and visual strategies while fostering positive interpersonal relationships
Understand organizational, time-management, and digital literacy skills to ensure efficiency and reliability in an office environment
Understand principles of business law and ethical decision-making to ensure compliance and integrity in professional practices
Understand career development using digital job platforms, networking tools, and strategies for long-term professional growth
Understand foundational economic and financial literacy used to make informed personal and business decisions
eligibility_notes: Any middle level contestant may enter this objective event.
